_doc: Caps enforced by engine/labcore.py. Exceeding a cap moves the job to ESCALATED (infra caps move it to BLOCKED). Per-cycle caps (revisions, fix_attempts, infra_retries, agent_calls_per_job) reset on resume and some on reject; the lifetime caps (lifetime_agent_calls, lifetime_revisions, lifetime_resumes, input_rounds, repairs) never reset. A resume past lifetime_resumes is refused: cancel, or start a new job with --continue-from. fix_attempts caps the fix_with loop after a failed script stage; fanout_max caps any fanout item list; repairs caps the one-re-ask-per-call repair retries (invalid output, severity directive). usage_ceiling (per job lifetime, provisional until T1.4): tokens as the app reports them (cache included) when any call reported tokens; agent_minutes always; reaching either pauses the job (ESCALATED), and only the approver can raise it (engine/gate.py ceiling). per_call_warning_tokens flags a call in the usage summary without stopping the job. fetches_per_call and fetches_per_job cap engine/evidence.py fetch (enforced by the fetch script).

usage_ceiling._provisional: PROVISIONAL until the first factory job (Phase 2). Set in T1.4 from the first real job (thin-v0, 4 headless calls, 23,618 tokens, 0.87 agent minutes; largest call 6,806 tokens, longest 17.6 s): agent_calls_per_job (25) x 7,000 tokens x 2 margin = 350,000 tokens; 25 x 18 s x 2, rounded up = 20 agent minutes; per-call warning about 3x the largest call. The Orchestrator's main-session tokens are not included (until T5.2). Recalibrate from the first factory job (Phase 2).

evals._doc: Cost controls for evals/run_evals.py (T0.13). Before every run the runner prints a token and time estimate; above confirm_above_tokens the approver must confirm in their own terminal. A run stops when its actual tokens reach the larger of tokens_per_invocation and 1.5 times a confirmed estimate, or after max_runs_per_invocation agent calls.
